name: roast-my-design-system
description: Roast your design system with real data. A deterministic, zero-dependency scanner that counts everything that betrays a design system, from colours and their near-identical twins to greys, spacing values, typefaces, duplicated and never-imported components, inline styles, !important and arbitrary Tailwind values, scores it 0-100 against Ideal Design System norms and a 30-repo benchmark, generates a shareable HTML diagnosis, and with --rules writes the agent rules file (CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules) that stops the mess coming back.
author: Greg Kozakiewicz (https://gregkozakiewicz.com)
